subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Risible
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"risible"** means something that provokes laughter or is laughable. (हास्यास्पद)

 
 
• **Example: **His **risible** attempt at dancing had everyone in splits.
 
 
 
• **"Serious"** refers to something that is solemn or not intended to be funny. (गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example: **His **serious** demeanor during the meeting showed his dedication to the project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the **opposite** of **'risible' **is **'serious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Serious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Curious **(जिज्ञासु): Eager to know or learn something.

 
 
• **Example:** She was curious about the new technology being introduced in the market.
 
 
 
• **Droll **(रंजक): Amusing in an odd or whimsical way.
 
 
• **Example: **His droll sense of humor always lightens the mood.
 
 
 
• **Giddy **(चक्कर): Having a sensation of whirling and a tendency to fall or stagger; dizzy.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt giddy after spinning around so quickly.
